PlanId release and TypeScript universe fields commit the signed manifest/profile, exact provider/runtime artifact and descriptor digests, protocol/build/runtime/compiler/platform identities, and resolved TypeScript universe.

findingDispositions.resolution: PLAN-ID-V1 defines one host owner and C-2 lifecycle point; thirteen closed preimage fields; exact domain, recipe version, tags, framing and CVE1 byte grammar; SHA-256 text form; PlanIntent/Snapshot/DELIVERY/config/grant/workflow joins; supplied-versus-recomputed verification; one exact byte-length/hash oracle, two exact transformations, and seven rejection vectors.
findingDispositions.residualEvidence: No independent Rust implementation of CVE1/PLAN-ID-V1, persisted PlanDescriptor reader, cache/replay verifier, or release execution record exists. Qualification requires retained positive and every negative-control result from an implementation that does not reuse the Python checker as its encoder.

findingDispositions.resolution: REQUEST-ID-V1 assigns host ingress allocation and RequestContext/EventEnvelope validation, fixes pre-parse allocation for rejected/admitted/stored-view/mutation requests, canonical 128-bit representation, atomic reservation with eight-candidate collision exhaustion, external/internal retry semantics, custody, and exact exclusion from every analysis/Run identity and semantic outcome.
findingDispositions.residualEvidence: No built host ingress, atomic request registry, collision-injection harness, RequestContext propagation test, or release execution record exists. Qualification and demonstration evidence arrays remain empty.
